usdRate.sourceName: Banco Central de Reserva del Peru (BCRP) statistics: banking system exchange rate (SBS), buy and sell, 30 October 2026
usdRate.note: Mid of buy 3.458 and sell 3.467 soles per dollar on 30 October 2026 (BCRP series PD04639PD and PD04640PD); World Bank average 3.567 for 2025.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, Peru inflation rate (INEI, Lima Metropolitan CPI)
inflation_cpi.note: Secondary source: year-on-year CPI inflation 5.25% in October 2026 (4.55% in September, confirmed by BCRP series PN01273PM), above the BCRP 1-3% target range.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BCRP inflation target 2% (range 1-3%); CPI 5.25% in October 2026 (Trading Economics)
inflation_projection.note: The 2% target has been credible over the long run, but inflation has been above the range for most of 2026, so we plan with 3%, the top of the band.

policy_rate.sourceName: BCRP statistics: monetary policy reference rate (series PD12301MD)
policy_rate.note: Reference rate 4.25% through 30 October 2026; held at the October 2026 meeting (Trading Economics: 13th straight hold).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: BCRP statistics: average interest rates of banks in soles, savings deposits (series PN07811NM)
savings_account_rate.note: Average effective annual rate on savings deposits in soles at banks, September 2026 (0.86%).

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: BCRP statistics: average interest rates of banks in soles, term deposits 31-180 days (series PN07813NM)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Average rate on term deposits of 31-180 days in soles at banks, September 2026 (3.89%); the BCRP does not publish a separate 90-day bucket.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: BCRP statistics: average interest rates of banks in soles, term deposits 181-360 days (series PN07814NM)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Average rate on term deposits of 181-360 days in soles at banks, September 2026 (4.29%); deposits of 360 days or more averaged 4.63%.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with a published industry rate was found in Peru.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: BCRP statistics: average interest rates of banks in soles, TIPMN average deposit rate (series PN07816NM)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate on all deposits in soles (TIPMN), September 2026 (2.01%); World Bank FR.INR.DPST gives 4.82% for 2022.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found; the Republic issues Letras del Tesoro and Bonos Soberanos, which are market securities, not fixed-rate retail certificates.

tbill_91d_rate.note: BCRP publishes Letras del Tesoro yields, but its statistics site blocks automated reading; no other public 3-month figure found.

tbond_5y_rate.note: BCRP publishes the sovereign yield curve, but its statistics site blocks automated reading; Trading Economics shows only the 10-year yield.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: BCRP statistics: yield of the 10-year Peruvian government bond in soles (series PD31895MM)
tbond_10y_rate.note: Monthly average yield 6.52% in September 2026; Trading Economics shows about 6.30-6.32% in late October and early November 2026.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: SUNAT, Texto Unico Ordenado de la Ley del Impuesto a la Renta, chapter IV, article 19 inciso i)
tax_bank_interest.note: Article 19 i) exempts interest on deposits under the Banking Law (Ley 26702) for individuals; the article 19 exemptions are extended to 31 December 2026, so a 5% tax on capital income could apply from 2027 unless extended again.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: SUNAT, Ley del Impuesto a la Renta, article 19 inciso h)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No retail savings certificate exists; interest and gains on Letras del Tesoro and Bonos Soberanos issued by the Republic are exempt (article 19 h), also extended to 31 December 2026.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Fondo de Seguro de Depositos (FSD): maximum coverage September-November 2026
deposit_insurance_limit.note: S/ 123,000 per depositor per member institution (banks, finance companies, municipal and rural savings banks), updated quarterly.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: BCRP statistics: average interest rates of banks in soles, consumer credit cards (series PN07845NM)
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Typical rate: average effective annual rate on consumer credit card balances in soles at banks, September 2026 (64.77%); the BCRP also sets a half-yearly legal cap that was not checked.

equity_return_low.note: Low case: the Lima stock exchange is concentrated in mining shares and can have weak decades.

equity_return_base.note: Base case: the tax-free 6.5% sovereign yield plus about 2 points of equity premium, held well below safe rate plus 4 because the local index is narrow and volatile.

equity_return_high.note: High case if metal prices and local shares repeat a strong decade.

gold_return_low.sourceName: BCRP: about 3.46 soles per dollar (30 October 2026); World Bank average 3.57 for 2025
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price while the sol stays strong.

gold_return_base.sourceName: BCRP: about 3.46 soles per dollar (30 October 2026); World Bank average 3.57 for 2025
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4.5% plus a little sol depreciation; the sol has been one of the most stable currencies in the region.

gold_return_high.sourceName: BCRP: about 3.46 soles per dollar (30 October 2026); World Bank average 3.57 for 2025
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold prices.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: a mix of savings accounts and short term deposits.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BCRP: term deposits 3.89-4.63%, 10-year sovereign 6.52% (September 2026); interest tax-exempt until 31 December 2026
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of term deposits around 4-4.6% and sovereign bonds, both tax-free today (a 5% tax would apply if the exemption lapses).

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: holding sovereign bonds to maturity at about 6%.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The SBS publishes insurance statistics, but its pages block automated reading; no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life (seguro de vida temporal) is sold in Peru, but no regulator or public source publishing premium rates by age was found; only individual insurer quotes exist.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No official figure for a typical major private clinic stay in Peru was found (SUSALUD and Ministry of Health sources not reachable).

health_premium_table.note: No regulator or public source publishing private health insurance premiums by age was found.

goal_inflation_health.note: No long-run health CPI series could be read; planning inflation (3%) plus 1.5 points for private clinic costs.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Peru CPI education component +3.54% year on year (October 2026, Trading Economics)
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices rose about 3.5% in the latest year; we plan with 4%, planning inflation plus 1 point for private schooling and university.

life_expectancy.note: UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 78.3 for 2026 (men 76.0, women 80.6).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 14.15 (2025, World Bank), 21.0 (2040) and 39.4 (2065, https://www.populationpyramid.net/peru/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: ONP (gob.pe): Solicitar pension de jubilacion segun D.L. 19990
retirement_age_default.note: National Pension System (SNP): pension at 65 with at least 20 years (240 contribution units); the private AFP system (SPP) also uses 65 as the legal retirement age.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: ONP (gob.pe): Solicitar pension de jubilacion segun D.L. 19990
retirement_age_government.note: Public servants hired today join the SNP or the AFP system, both with pension age 65; the compulsory end-of-service age in the civil service (reported as 70) could not be confirmed from a readable official page.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: mostly savings and short deposits.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BCRP: term deposits 181-360 days 4.29% (September 2026); deposit interest tax-exempt until 31 December 2026
retirement_return_base.note: Base case at or below the 1-year deposit rate after tax (4.29% exempt today, about 4.1% if the 5% tax returned): rolling term deposits in retirement.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: part of savings in tax-free sovereign bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if equities disappoint.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: half equities at 8.5% and half deposits and bonds around 4.5%, after the 5% tax on share gains.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case with stronger equity returns.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Programa Nacional de Asistencia Solidaria Pension 65 (gob.pe)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Pension 65 is paid every two months: S/ 250 plus a S/ 100 increase approved for 2025-2026, i.e. S/ 350 every two months (S/ 175 a month), per gob.pe as read by the researcher. HelpAge Pension Watch lists the S/ 350 payment (https://www.helpage.org/country_profile/peru/); gob.pe blocked automated reading on re-check.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Programa Nacional de Asistencia Solidaria Pension 65 (gob.pe)
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: For people 65 and over in extreme poverty (household targeting system SISFOH) without another pension; HelpAge Pension Watch also gives age 65, poverty targeted.

gratuity_rule.note: Peru has a statutory length-of-service compensation (CTS) deposited by employers twice a year, but no readable official page with the rule was found (Labour Ministry and SUNAFIL pages unreachable), so the days per year were not recorded.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: ONP (gob.pe): pension de jubilacion segun D.L. 19990
public_pension_scheme.note: National Pension System (SNP, run by ONP): pension at 65 after 20 years of contributions, minimum S/ 600 and maximum S/ 1,000 a month (4% health contribution deducted). Workers may instead join a private AFP. No automatic indexation; tax treatment not confirmed.

savings_account.note: Interest exempt from income tax until 31 December 2026; deposits covered by the FSD.

fdr_3m.note: Offered by banks, finance companies and municipal savings banks; average 3.89% for 31-180 days (BCRP, September 2026).

fdr_1y.note: Offered by banks, finance companies and municipal savings banks; average 4.29% for 181-360 days (BCRP, September 2026).

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with a published industry rate.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals.

tbill_91d.note: Issued by the Ministry of Economy and Finance; mostly bought by institutions; interest tax-exempt (article 19 h).

tbond_5y.note: Soles bonds issued by the Republic; bought through brokers; interest tax-exempt (article 19 h).

tbond_10y.note: Soles bonds issued by the Republic.

equity_fund.note: Regulated by the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores (SMV); equity and mixed funds are available to retail investors.

gold.note: No legal restriction on buying gold.

centralBank.name: Banco Central de Reserva del Perú (BCRP)

insuranceRegulator.name: Superintendencia de Banca, Seguros y AFP (SBS)

insuranceComplaints.name: Superintendencia de Banca, Seguros y AFP (SBS), user services
insuranceComplaints.note: Complaints go first to the insurer, then to the SBS.

pensionScheme.name: Oficina de Normalización Previsional (ONP), Sistema Nacional de Pensiones

oldAgeAllowance.name: Programa Nacional de Asistencia Solidaria Pensión 65

publicHealthCover.name: Seguro Integral de Salud (SIS)
publicHealthCover.note: State-subsidised health insurance for people without other cover; formal employees are covered by EsSalud.

statistics.name: Instituto Nacional de Estadística e Informática (INEI)
